label: China AI regulation · H200 import block lifted (mid-2027)
prompt:
Will US-licensed NVIDIA H200 accelerators be clearing Chinese customs in commercial volume to mainland customers by 30 June 2027?

Resolving yes rebinds the China model to params/import-thaw.json.
resolution_criteria: Resolves YES on credible reporting (company disclosure, customs data or two independent major outlets) of commercial-volume H200 deliveries to mainland Chinese customers. Isolated deliveries or offshore-cloud access do not count.

diagnostics.label: Customs block
diagnostics.note: Early-2026 customs holds plus window guidance toward domestic chips.

diagnostics.label: Self-sufficiency push
diagnostics.note: Domestic accelerator capacity growth reduces Beijing's incentive to relent.
